title: A Trip to the Shop
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs milk, bread and apples. The shop is big and the prices are good. She buys a new bag too.

At the shop, Anna pays with a card. The cashier smiles and says hello. Anna is happy because the apples are cheap. She goes home with her shopping.

questions.text: What does Anna need to buy?
How does Anna pay at the shop?
Why is Anna happy at the shop?
How does the cashier probably feel?

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy things
round fruits that are red, green or yellow
a person who takes money from customers in a shop

paragraph_translations: Anna cumartesi günü dükkana gider. Süt, ekmek ve elma almaya ihtiyacı vardır. Dükkan büyüktür ve fiyatlar iyidir. Yeni bir çanta da alır.
Dükkanda Anna kartla öder. Kasiyer gülümser ve merhaba der. Elmalar ucuz olduğu için Anna mutludur. Alışverişiyle birlikte eve gider.
